svg.aria-label: Unified memory, in testing: 100% of the game's graphics memory shared with the GPU; 97.4% of GPU memory views fit directly; 64 million lookups served with no copy in one live session; 121 million descriptor rows checked against real gameplay with zero errors; 300 times less memory bookkeeping per heavy frame, about 18 seconds down to about 60 milliseconds on an RTX 5080; no memory left behind after closing.
svg.title: Unified memory: key figures
